name: magnetoid/wp-safe-mode-ai
description: AI-driven WordPress file and database editing behind a session-scoped safe mode, with snapshot, lint, diff, approval, verify and auto-revert-on-fatal.
_comment_runtime_deps: There are deliberately no runtime dependencies. This plugin ships as a drop-in folder, so anything in vendor/ would have to be committed — and a committed Guzzle or PSR-7 implementation is the single most common cause of fatal class collisions between WordPress plugins. The Claude client is therefore written against WordPress' own HTTP API (see src/Agent/ClaudeClient.php), which also inherits the site's proxy and TLS configuration for free. vendor/ exists for development tooling only and is not required at runtime.
